extras: Desktop only (macOS, Windows, Linux); mobile is not supported.
motivation: To allow users to translate clipped articles or transcripts into their reading language without leaving the editor.
problem: Users need a way to translate content directly within the Obsidian editor without leaving the application.

relations.evidence: Derived from obsidian-llm-shortcut by chernodub — the streaming output layer and OpenAI-compatible request adapter are based on that work.

requires.name: API key from at least one supported provider

summary: LLM Translate is a plugin that translates selected text or entire notes using various LLM providers, preserving YAML frontmatter and supporting streaming output.
